feeds.title: Rachel Cooks
feeds.description: Hi, I am Rachel! This site features a wide variety of recipes with one common thread: easy preparations. I love creating accessible and delicious food that will please the whole family. Have a seat at my table...let's chat, eat, and have fun!

feeds.title: The Lemon Bowl Blog
feeds.description: Liz shares delicious recipes that use real whole foods that are easy to make, big on flavor, and good for you, by using real ingredients with an emphasis on seasonality. Get the healthy recipes that taste delicious at The Lemon Bowl.

feeds.title: FeelGoodFoodie
feeds.description: Browse a wide variety of healthy recipes with feel good ingredients PACKED with nutrition. Stay on track with your health goals and leave your body feeling energized and nourished.

feeds.title: Crowded Kitchen
feeds.description: Hi, we're Lexi and Beth, a mother-daughter team from Michigan. The recipes you'll find here are a reflection of how we bring our family together around the dinner table despite various dietary differences.

feeds.title: This Worthey Life Blog
feeds.description: Tatanisha, mom of three teen boys is a food blogger with her husband Derrick Worthey at 'This Worthey Life'. This Worthey Life inspires everyone to live a 'worthy' life by sharing their passion through food, travel, entertainment, and life adventures, helping parents through the tween and teen years of parenting boys by empowering them with our personal stories and experiences.

feeds.title: Foxes Love Lemons
feeds.description: Hi, I am Lori! I am a Detroit-area culinary school graduate, food photographer, recipe developer, and English muffin fanatic. Foxes Love Lemons is a food blog that focuses on recipes that use simple culinary school techniques to make you a better home cook.

feeds.title: Just Short of Crazy » FOOD + WINE
feeds.description: Articles on Food and Wine by Deb. She is a Midwest lifestyle blogger (Michigan is home) who shares practical tips for everyday living on her blog and across her social media. She is always looking for ways to make life easier for herself and her audience so that there is more time for fun.

feeds.title: Taste the Local Difference Blog
feeds.description: Taste the Local Difference connects consumers to local farms, food producers, restaurants, community farmers' markets, retailers, and more. Their mission is to help food businesses and the communities they serve benefit from the economic value of local food while ensuring that fresh, healthy, local food is available to all consumers.

feeds.title: Michigan Chews & Brews
feeds.description: Exploring Michigan one plate and drink at a time. Our goal is to encourage people to eat, drink, and be merry at local establishments. We strive to highlight the best the Michigan has to offer, one plate and brew at a time.

feeds.title: Kitchen Joy
feeds.description: Welcome to Kitchen Joy! I strive to create reliable, flavorful, family-friendly recipes that showcase quality ingredients and approachable techniques to ensure your success in the kitchen.

feeds.title: Amanda's Plate
feeds.description: Hi! I am Amanda. I love to share the extra special recipes from my childhood. I have been cooking and baking since I was a little tot. My passion grew when I realized, I could create things my family and friends would enjoy. To me, there is no better way to tell someone you love them than to create a delicious meal for them.

feeds.title: Blogging and Living » Food
feeds.description: This section of the blog features articles on Food by Jasmine Martin. Jasmine is your friendly introverted Hufflepuff - Slytherin hybrid lifestyle blogger! I discuss all things lifestyle including beauty, fashion, food, blogging, pop culture, relationships, & self-care advice.

feeds.title: The Bite Tonight Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Jewell. A food blogger, home chef, lover of tacos, and Thai takeout. Welcome to my blog where you will find recipes and honest restaurant reviews of the hottest spots in metro Detroit. OK, some are local dives, but I promise, they are dishing out some killer dishes. I seek to push the envelope and find unique, delicious eats. I also love to cook, especially with others so you may see a recipe here and there. The Bite Tonight focuses on vegetarian and vegan dishes and features restaurant reviews and recipes.

feeds.title: Reserve Wine & Food Blog
feeds.description: Reserve Wine & Food is a top-rated restaurant in Grand Rapids offering a world-class wine list and rotating menu made with locally sourced ingredients.

feeds.title: Dash Of Evans
feeds.description: My name is Ashleigh and I live in Grand Rapids, Michigan. As a busy mom of 4, I love to share delicious home-cooked meals, with a little help from the store. I also love to show people how to save money. My blog is a mixing bowl of ideas, hence the Dash of Evans name a dash of tips, a dash of food a dash of the Evans family!

feeds.title: Girls Gone Hungry
feeds.description: Hi! We are 2 Sisters exploring Detroit for good eats, drinks, and treats.

feeds.title: GoNanas
feeds.description: Check out our Vegan and Gluten Free banana bread that's good for your body and soul! Here are some of the best banana bread recipes.
